reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1 skipped (missing-validation finding). Gate 2: entry point is handle_liquidation called by untrusted external liquidators; no trust_assumptions in scope file. Gate 3: market.move is in_scope and liquidation logic is a named focus_area. An attacker (liquidator) can trigger this via handle_liquidation by liquidating an obligation whose debt is between min_borrow_amount and 2×min_borrow_amount, causing liquidation_inner to call unsafe_repay_debt_only without enforce_post_borrow_repay_invariant, leaving remaining debt below min_borrow_amount as an irrecoverable dust position that accumulates as bad debt. PoC poc_036_liquidation_dust_position.move proves exploitability with concrete parameters (150 USDC debt → 75 USDC dust below 100 USDC min_borrow_amount).
